---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
mallards <- read_rds("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| message: false

mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = fct_rev(month))) +
  geom_density_ridges(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard Movement Speeds by Month",
    x = "Speed (m/s)",
    y = "Month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
